about: Wave-tops script fixtures (ruled 2026-11-23). Self-authored: every name, code, place and address is invented (QXA-QXD are not airport codes in the snapshot); dates are synthetic, run date Sunday 2027-03-07, all inside standard time. Records are in the persisted grouping (_log_records) shape. 'overrides' is the in-memory destination table test_wavetops_script.py swaps in for the run and restores after; no file is written. 'cases' run through wavetops.script(); 'line_cases' feed one fact-sheet row to wavetops._line for rows select() cannot reach. Expectations are pinned from a captured run Nick read, never typed ahead of it. Re-pinned 2026-11-25 (R1-R19): stays are titled 'Stay: ' and carry the build_records start/end roles; the trip is a ranked tier-2 item; multi-day entries, entries under way, texts and the calendar member that speaks added; pinned from a captured run read before pinning.

cases.name: chain_plus_twin_first_leg
cases.clause: Ruled addition 2026-11-23, rule amended the same day: a two-leg chain plus a bare-clock twin of the first leg. Identical pairs dedupe to their first zoned member, the two zoned legs chain, and the twin's pair is already a leg, so the chain's final destination is spoken. (First rule: 'pairs disagree', no destination.)
